answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, forcing agents to expend computational energy to validate network states. An attacker seeking to flood the system must expend immense resources, acting like a sparrow against a storm, to manifest identities beyond the current reef of consensus. This economic barrier ensures that identity generation carries a verifiable cost in umber tokens, effectively rendering the deployment of infinite fake agents prohibitively expensive for malicious actors.
